title: [GMCP 203.009.05] Interoperability and quality: Complete tool server surface
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-009-05. Prove applicable official-suite and reference-SDK interoperability in both roles, direct-versus-gateway differential behavior, property invariants, transport and platform parity, and published latency, throughput, startup, memory, disk, and fairness budgets. Retain regression fixtures for every incompatibility found. Vector outcome: Tool discovery, deterministic pagination/filtering, list-change signaling, invocation, structured and unstructured results, output-schema validation, annotations, icons, errors, cancellation, progress, caching, idempotency declarations, and concurrent execution all work through the production registry. Tool identity and schema changes are versioned, calls are policy-gated, and success is impossible when declared output contracts are violated. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
